Government Services

Apply for Certificate of Good Conduct

Directorate of Criminal Investigations · Fee KSh 1,050

Before you apply

You will need your national ID card. Fingerprints are taken at a DCI office after you pay.

Processing usually takes up to 14 working days after your fingerprints are taken.

Terms

The information you give must be true. False information is an offence.

The fee is not refundable once fingerprints have been taken.

Your certificate can be downloaded from your account when it is ready.

Need help?

Visit any Huduma centre or DCI office.
